title: Model Resilience Propensity Index & Field Probe Playbook
creator: Ava Nguyen
description: Define a lightweight, operational index (Model Resilience Propensity Index, MRPI) to quantify risk of service-impacting model supply events for customers and produce a reproducible field-probe playbook that triggers procurement/rollout actions. The MRPI combines telemetry signals (latency/availability drift, quantization regressions, provenance churn), model compatibility fragility, and regional capacity volatility into a single actionable score with thresholds that map to playbook steps (investigate, canary, procurement alert, fallback activation).
acceptance_criteria: 1) MRPI score spec documented with contributor formulas and sample calculations for three representative customers; 2) Field probe playbook drafted with step-by-step runbook (investigate -> canary -> procurement trigger -> rollback); 3) Two synthetic probe workloads implemented and runnable in CI; 4) Prototype dashboard mock (console) visualizing MRPI by region/model; 5) Stakeholder sign-off from SRE, Sales Ops, and Solutions Engineering.
metrics: Time from MRPI alert to canary kickoff < 60m
Procurement-triggered capacity provision lead time captured
MRPI correlation with customer incidents (target rho > 0.45)
notes: Rationale: customers increasingly ask for proactive model-fallback triggers rather than reactive SLAs; MRPI should be lightweight and explainable.
Trade-off: include model-behavioral regressions (quality) vs keeping index operationally simple. Start with telemetry + supply signals, add quality signal v2.

Decision so far: normalize signals to 0-100 and weight by observed incident contribution (initial weights: telemetry 50, capacity volatility 30, compatibility 20). We will recalibrate after 4 weeks of probes.
Potential follow-ups: integrate MRPI into Console alerts and create per-customer tuning profiles for enterprise accounts.
